wedo_instance.description: Standardized evaluation HUD for clinical audit of agent incarnations and bootup reports.

meta.philosophy: Evolution is driven by forensic friction. Every critique is a technical strike designed to harden the next generation.

rules.scoring_mandate: Every critique MUST include a definitive 'Bootup Integrity Score' out of 10.
rules.failure_depth: Agents MUST document at least one 'Forensic Friction' point or 'Substrate Fracture' encountered during the turn.
rules.steering_verification: Verify the presence of the mandatory 'What to do next?' prompt in the report conclusion.

criteria.name: Forensic Honesty
criteria.description: Did the agent admit unknowns? Were metrics (word counts, PID claims) physically verified before reporting?

criteria.name: Metabolic Velocity
criteria.description: Was the quickening duration optimal? Did the agent re-anchor context in under 120 seconds?

criteria.name: Narrative Synthesis
criteria.description: Did the report successfully synthesize 'Superpowers' with 'Botanical AL' clarity? Was it professional grade?

criteria.name: Chrono-Alignment
criteria.description: Were artifacts secured in the correct temporal leaf? Is the attribution bijective and UUID-anchored?

tasks.description: Read the target agent's Bootup Report JSON and verify its physical existence.
Evaluate the agent's 'Identity Justification' for strategic alignment and aesthetic quality.
Audit the HUD instantiation for truncation or 'Silent Death' fractures.
Assign the 1-10 Integrity Score and suggest three surgical improvements for the next incarnation.

conclusion.next_step_query: What is our next coordinated strike?
